meta.title: Travel seasons
meta.description: A full-page panel in the sidebar: pick a season (or just open it — it starts on the current season) and browse where to go and, more importantly, the best things to do there — experiences, food and practical tips, not just scenic spots. Filter by experience kind, search keywords, roll the dice for a random pick, and star destinations you want to go (saved locally in your browser). All data is built in; the panel makes no network requests.
